programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan resents their fraudulent ways. However, when fate shows him a route to redeeming their reputation, will he survive it?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hu's caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Stephen Chow stars in this parody on the popular Judge Pao stories, depicting how he helps a rape victim fight the system against corrupt lawyers & officials.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written & directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband & son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Feng defies his father and leaves home to pursue his dream of becoming an auto mechanic. Along the way, he unexpectedly finds himself drawn into the thrilling world of car racing.

programme.title: Someday or One Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a TV series, the movie follows Huang as she mourns for her boyfriend's death and receives a mysterious cassette player to travel back in time. Will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wife's divorce request and his father's illness.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A family running a Chinese dessert shop faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. This heartfelt journey reveals the strength of family bonds, sacrifices, and resilience.

programme.title: Ready o/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan research news from across a popular BBS forum. Xiang, a forum founder, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas but being the subject of heated debate due to a leaked video.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Ip Man fights some gangsters to protect a school, and is challenged by a Wing Chun master. He accepts the duel for his family and disciples and emerges victorious, securing the Grandmaster title.

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: The Fierce Wife
programme.desc: An Zhen divorces her husband after his infidelity but faces a pivotal decision four years later - to return to her cheating husband and old life or to embark on a new life with a new love?

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer gathers a team of thieves to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their plan alters upon finding the legendary 'Moonwatch', leading to a perilous heist amidst a yakuza pursuit.

programme.title: The Way We Talk
programme.desc: Three deaf youths—Wolf, Sophie and Alan—develop a profound bond and support each other through sign language. United by love and friendship, they embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Donnie Yen, Chow Yun Fat & Aaron Kwok star in this classic-inspired tale of the Monkey King's legendary Journey To The West.

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: A failed drug raid leaves an undercover cop trapped and a drug lord vowing to seek revenge. Senior Police Inspector Li resorts to blackmailing a drug dealer with his daughter to arrest the drug lord.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhen's family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles?

programme.title: Old Fox

programme.title: Fox Hunt

programme.title: Someone Like Me

programme.title: Lelio Popo

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yong's novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences.

programme.title: 东京审判第二季:超越胜者的审判
programme.desc: 东京审判是人类有史以来参与国家最多、规模最大、开庭时间最长、留下档案文献最为浩瀚的审判，也是仍然影响着当下的一场审判。在这个没有硝烟的战场上，中国代表团是如何克服万难取得胜利？作为国家元首的日本天皇为何没有坐上审判席？为什么日本国内仍然有一部分人试图否定东京审判？时隔70年，这场审判似乎仍然没有画上句点。上海外语频道制作的三集系列纪录片《东京审判》，远赴美国与日本，将以独家采集的罕见影像资料重现这一段风云际会的历史；而中、日、美、德各国专家学者，也将拨云见日，解读这场审判留下的点点疑惑和历史因果。很多日本学者因担心被误解，之前从未接受过中国媒体的采访，而此次也破例出现在了镜头前，向人们表明真相究竟是什么。值得一提的是，日本前首相鸠山由纪夫也接受了节目的专访，他在采访中提到了对于东京审判的态度，对于安倍政府的看法，以及对战后七十年中日关系的展望。

programme.title: 航拍中国2
programme.desc: 由中央电视台出品，央视纪录国际传媒有限公司承制的大型航拍纪录片《航拍中国》是一部以空中视角俯瞰中国，全方位、立体化展示中国历史人文景观、自然地理风貌及经济社会发展变化的纪录片。该系列片共34集，每集50分钟，覆盖全国23个省、5个自治区、4个直辖市和2个特别行政区。本片影像将全部由航拍完成，每集选取各省市区最具代表性和观赏性的历史、人文、自然和现代景观，以空中飞行线路为线索，以故事化的叙事方式展现一个观众既熟悉又充满新鲜感的美丽中国、生态中国、文明中国。

programme.title: 相声大会
programme.desc: 《相声大会》是由天津卫视打造的情景式全方位呈现津味茶楼的相声文化。从浓郁的中国式环境布置，到精致的相声水牌、盖碗茶具，从小二哥的吆喝声，到观众叫好、上花篮等，置身电视相声茶楼，让观众体验老天津卫原汁原味的茶楼相声氛围；让幽默、欢乐和爆笑成为天津百姓的周末视听盛宴。

programme.title: 晚间剧场:大宅院的女人(31-32)
programme.desc: 故事发生在民国时期。因报林家救命之恩，开钱庄的白老太爷（雷恪生 饰）被迫答应十五岁独子白子义（魏韩 饰）娶长他八岁的林家长女林燕娇（马晓静 饰）为妻，殊不知这是林老太爷（英达 饰）为将来侵吞白家财产所设的局。林燕娇（王丽云 饰）嫁入白家十几年未曾生育，她自做主张将亲戚余梅兰塞给王子义（田小洁 饰）做偏房，一年后余氏生下一女，林燕娇狸猫换太子将其换成男孩，取名旺儿，并将其弟林望兴（荆洁 饰）安插在白家钱庄做事，打压为白家默默做事一辈子的李掌柜（郭勇 饰），妄图夺取白家全部财产。为巩固在白家的地位，林燕娇可谓不择手段，她利用陪嫁丫头香菱（虞梦 饰），对白子义娶进家门的姨太太们施展了穷尽的本领……

programme.title: 消费者
programme.desc: 消费是经济链条中最显著最接近普通大众的环节，作为以经济领域报道为主的主流媒体，这也是滨海频道一直重点关注的领域。2012年《我们都是消费者》正式播出。“消费有学问、消费有智慧、消费有保障”成为新栏目的座右铭，科学引导消费，揭露消费领域中的种种陷阱，这些都成为《我们都是消费者》关注的热点。

programme.title: 都市报道60分

programme.title: 精英剧场:沉默的荣耀(34)
programme.desc: 1949年8月，本来要在福州迎接解放的吴石，突然被蒋介石任命为国民政府国防部次长。为了获得更多情报，吴石按照党组织的指示毅然前往台湾就职，利用工作便利陆续向中共华东局提供了有关金门岛兵力变化、西南战役国军调动等重要情报。原本要回上海的朱枫在得知吴石原来的交通员牺牲、组织上需要派新的交通员去台湾时，也毅然放弃了阖家团圆的机会，只身去了台湾。吴石、朱枫密切合作，送出了多份重要情报。1950年2月，由于叛徒出卖，吴石、朱枫、陈宝仓和聂曦等人不幸被捕，牺牲在台北西马场町，但他们送出的舟山兵力部署图帮助解放军顺利解放舟山群岛，为全国解放事业作出了贡献。

programme.title: 风雨送春归33/40
programme.desc: 该剧以东江市纪委书记牛铁雷奉命率专案组调查危化品爆炸案腐败问题为切入口，讲述了党的十八大以来，以牛铁雷为代表，省纪委书记赵长海、区纪委书记孙方明，以及欧阳春、周强、宋天意等纪检干部，在查办腐败案件过程中经受的种种抉择和考验。在查处市环保腐败案、领导干预招投标案、利益集团包揽重大工程腐败案等案件中，克服了被调查人跳楼、利益集团阻碍调查等困难，经历了夫妻反目、父子成仇、战友断义、职务罢免、重病等现实问题，抵住了金钱、女色等诱惑，经受了恐吓、栽赃、追杀等考验，始终忠于职守，大智大勇，查处并瓦解了以省委副书记麦满仓为背景，其侄子麦思源为主谋，以市委书记余仲君和情妇林妙雪为代表的利益集团。

programme.title: 炮神(2)
programme.desc: 1927年，滇军策应广东革命政府北伐号召征讨军阀唐继尧，双方激战昆明城外。马夫兵杨志华凭借天赋一炮命中杜清时的战地指挥所，虽然战败被俘，却因神炮技艺死里逃生。杨志华阴差阳错考入讲武堂，和高材生杜清明冲突频发。但其得到教官枝野胜男的严酷训练，成为最没文化的神炮手。抗日战争爆发，杨志华加入八路军部队奔赴华北战场，意外与杜清明重逢。一个八路军营长，一个国民党教官，二人摒弃前嫌，携手抗敌，与枝野胜男多次较量，师生决战战场。枝野胜男出尽奇招，组建特种部队，杨志华的炮兵营多次陷入危机。历经挫折考验，杨志华和杜清明反败为胜，在关键战役打败枝野胜男而名声大噪。抗战胜利，国共分裂，杨志华和杜清明又在济南战役兵戎相见。杨志华冒险劝降，晓以大义。杜清明被杨志华所折服，为争取部队起义的时间而慷慨赴死。

programme.title: Top Chef
programme.desc: Fifteen of the competition's fiercest challengers return to face-off in the toughest season yet! A mise-en-place challenge set at the historic Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles kicks off the intense battle, where the Chefs immediately size each other up to see how everyone has progressed since last competing. Then, the first elimination challenge takes the Chefs to the beach to cook a seafood meal - however, their only heat source will be fire. No electricity, no special appliances. Back to basics. It's going to be a true slug-match to see who has the skills and who has the drive to take the one thing that has eluded them all… the title of Top Chef! Padma Lakshmi, Tom Colicchio, and Gail Simmons return as judges and joining them as the first guest judge of the season is legendary Chef, Jeremiah Tower. Marcus Samuelsson, Nancy Silverton, Michael Cimarusti, Josiah Citrin, Suzanne Goin, Caroline Styne share the table for the high-powered, high-stress beach-side meal.

programme.title: Top Chef
programme.desc: This week the chefs honor the late, great Pulitzer-Prize winning food critic Jonathan Gold. Using Gold's last guide list, the chefs fan out all over Los Angeles to sample the unique taquerias, food trucks, mom-and-pop cafes, upscale eateries and ethnic cuisine only found in the City of Angels. Drawing inspiration from this one-in-a-lifetime culinary odyssey, the chefs create dishes to serve 200 of Jonathan Gold's friends, family, and restaurateurs that he loved at the iconic Union Station. Noted food writer and personal friend of Jonathan Gold, Ruth Reichl serves as guest judge alongside Padma, Tom and Gail.

programme.title: 月牙泉剧场:大漠枪神(21)
programme.desc: 《大漠枪神》是钱雁秋编剧导演，张子健、淳于珊珊主演的电视剧，是“燕双鹰”电视剧系列第一部《英雄》的翻拍，讲述了身负血仇的青年——燕双鹰，孤身向盘踞在大漠的日伪余孽、土匪恶霸等恶势力挑战，身经百战，历尽凶险，终于成为大漠中第一号传奇英雄。然而，面对亲人朋友和无辜百姓一个个死去，燕双鹰毅然与解放军合作，最终走上革命道路，成为了真正的英雄。

programme.title: 传奇剧场:潜渊(29)
programme.desc: 1940年1月，头部受伤的我党地下工作者梁朔在深山暴雪中苏醒，他因伤失忆，根据线索来到上海寻找自己的身份却陷入日军围捕，因此怀疑自己是军统一员。汪伪76号的人也找到他，称他是行动处的处长。此时日汪政府联合举办的“和平共荣大会”即将召开，一批被日方严密囚禁的难民劳工也将在会后被推上战场，生命危在旦夕。我党制定“潜渊”计划，准备在大会召开之际解救同胞。在这关键时刻，执行计划的地下党员“清霜”却不知所踪。梁朔在日伪特务的重重陷阱下重新找回记忆，原来他就是“清霜”。梁朔坚持自己的红色信仰，以身涉险，重回76号寻找解救同胞们的机会。他获悉一份尘封了十余年的日谍名单也将在大会上被启用，为完成“潜渊”计划，他必须夺取名单。梁朔发动身边所有爱国力量，粉碎了日方阴谋，解救了千余名难民。

programme.title: 虎胆巍城
programme.desc: 1940年，浙东抗战形势愈发严峻，共产党员萧寒奉上级命令返回故乡望海，组建共产党领导的独立武装保卫望海，为望海保卫战的胜利起到了关键性作用。望海沦陷后，萧寒带领队伍在望海周边山区坚持游击抗日，以王贺乡为依托创建根据地并成立望海独立中队，在新四军浙东纵队的领导下，取得一系列战斗的胜利，根据地也逐步扩大。而此时国民党却奉行“消极抗战、积极反共”的政策，妄图联合日寇消灭我党的抗日队伍，萧寒和独立中队在面对敌、伪、顽的复杂斗争局面下，坚定共产主义信仰，高举统一抗战旗帜，浴血奋战，为整个浙东根据地的发展壮大做出了重要的贡献。 最终萧寒和独立中队在新四军浙东游击纵队的领导下，收复了望海县城。

programme.title: 沉默的荣耀(9)
programme.desc: 1949年8月，本来要在福州迎接解放的吴石，突然被蒋介石任命为国民政府国防部次长。为了获得更多情报，吴石按照党组织的指示毅然前往台湾就职，利用工作便利陆续向中共华东局提供了有关金门岛兵力变化、西南战役国军调动等重要情报。原本要回上海的朱枫在得知吴石原来的交通员牺牲、组织上需要派新的交通员去台湾时，也毅然放弃了阖家团圆的机会，只身去了台湾。吴石、朱枫密切合作，送出了多份重要情报。1950年2月，由于叛徒出卖，吴石、朱枫、陈宝仓和聂曦等人不幸被捕，牺牲在台北西马场町，但他们送出的舟山兵力部署图帮助解放军顺利解放舟山群岛，为全国解放事业作出了贡献。

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder
programme.desc: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo's biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australia's Wild West
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

programme.title: Wildlife Er
programme.desc: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

programme.title: Wildlife Er
programme.desc: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala's spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle's slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

programme.title: Wildlife Er
programme.desc: Head into surgery with Mara the koala, who needs a life-saving tooth operation, then assess an injured sugar glider with vet Tim. Cheer as rescue officer Elise pulls a flying fox out of a gutter and see nurse Bree's clutch of python eggs hatch.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Dash across southeast Queensland as breeding and snake-catching season ramp up. Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python.

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours To Survive
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Wild Tales From The Farm
programme.desc: It's spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

programme.title: Wild Tales From The Farm
programme.desc: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

programme.title: The Living Beach
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankind's effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living… on the “living beach”?

programme.title: Extreme Africa
programme.desc: Etosha was once a great lake that dried up and now only fills with water seasonally during the summer rains. Once the Etosha pan is full of water, a myriad of water birds congregate in the shallow lake to breed, most notably Greater and lesser flamingos.

programme.title: Extreme Africa

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs

programme.title: Dogs With Extraordinary Jobs

programme.title: Wild Birds Of Australia
programme.desc: The Emu is Australia's biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.desc: 曾获得射击冠军的神枪手唐余锦本是一名留德归来的全科医生，他在上海开设诊所，一边治病救人，一边暗中寻找当年刺杀自己父亲的凶手，恪守着不用枪伤人的准则。淞沪大战前夕，上海各界团结起来奋勇抗日。唐余锦原本置身事外，但是在他经历了与未婚妻以及家人相继死于日特枪下的痛楚之后，毅然投奔新四军，加入到对日本侵略者的剿灭中去，组织并参与了一场场惊心动魄的抗日斗争。在抗日烽火的洗礼中，唐余锦完成了一个普通百姓成长为抗日战士的光辉的历程，成为苏北战场上的抗日英雄。

programme.title: 平凡的世界(18)
programme.desc: 该剧根据著名作家路遥名著《平凡的世界》改编，上世纪70年代，自尊好强的农家子弟孙少平在原西县高中读书，与地主出身的郝红梅相互爱怜，后郝与家境优越的班长顾养民谈恋爱。同村同班的好友润生为此抱不平狠揍顾养民一顿。倔强的少平不肯承认自己失恋，但开始与自己过于自尊的自卑斗争，积极参加赴地区会演的排练。好读课外书的少平敏感、自尊，吸引着县领导的女儿田晓霞。少平高考落榜回乡劳动，在经历了大旱、抢水、死人的事件后，断然拒绝侯玉英以进城为诱的追求，远离故土，漂泊揽工。哥哥孙少安初中毕业就在家里劳动与村支书田福堂的女儿润叶青梅竹马，遭到田的剧烈反对。最终少安娶了勤劳善良的山西姑娘秀莲，转型开办了烧砖窑，走上了致富路。

programme.title: 玩转地球
programme.desc: 《玩转地球》是旅游卫视与Discovery合作的引进类栏目。节目自2004年7月播出至今，已经播出近500余期。目前已经形成了稳定而特征鲜明的收视群体。 《玩转地球》是由Discovery授权播出的具有国际品质的旅游探索纪录片。每周分为《美食之旅》、《顶级假期》、《旅游探险精选》、《旅游大热门》《旅游怪谭》等多个主题，带领观众饱览异国风情、体验神奇探索、品尝天下美食。足不出户，玩转地球！

programme.title: 热血剧场:康熙微服私访记
programme.desc: 《康熙微服私访记》是自1997年至2007年共出品五部的中国大陆古装剧。该剧以康熙微服私访为线索，既有康熙在平民社会的生活写照，也有他惩治贪官威武的一面。故事描述了康熙年间黄河连年泛滥，沿岸百姓苦不堪言，康熙皇帝体恤民情励志治河，亲自九下江南巡视黄河灾情，更由此引出了一幕幕传颂一时的传奇故事。

programme.title: 沉默的荣耀(20)
programme.desc: 1949年8月，本来要在福州迎接解放的吴石，突然被蒋介石任命为国民政府国防部次长。为了获得更多情报，吴石按照党组织的指示毅然前往台湾就职，利用工作便利陆续向中共华东局提供了有关金门岛兵力变化、西南战役国军调动等重要情报。原本要回上海的朱枫在得知吴石原来的交通员牺牲、组织上需要派新的交通员去台湾时，也毅然放弃了阖家团圆的机会，只身去了台湾。吴石、朱枫密切合作，送出了多份重要情报。1950年2月，由于叛徒出卖，吴石、朱枫、陈宝仓和聂曦等人不幸被捕，牺牲在台北西马场町，但他们送出的舟山兵力部署图帮助解放军顺利解放舟山群岛，为全国解放事业作出了贡献。

programme.title: 虎胆巍城(18)
programme.desc: 1940年，浙东抗战形势愈发严峻，共产党员萧寒奉上级命令返回故乡望海，组建共产党领导的独立武装保卫望海，为望海保卫战的胜利起到了关键性作用。望海沦陷后，萧寒带领队伍在望海周边山区坚持游击抗日，以王贺乡为依托创建根据地并成立望海独立中队，在新四军浙东纵队的领导下，取得一系列战斗的胜利，根据地也逐步扩大。而此时国民党却奉行“消极抗战、积极反共”的政策，妄图联合日寇消灭我党的抗日队伍，萧寒和独立中队在面对敌、伪、顽的复杂斗争局面下，坚定共产主义信仰，高举统一抗战旗帜，浴血奋战，为整个浙东根据地的发展壮大做出了重要的贡献。 最终萧寒和独立中队在新四军浙东游击纵队的领导下，收复了望海县城。

programme.title: 我是杜拉拉(闽)15-16
programme.desc: 三十岁的职场精英杜拉拉，不日就要问鼎总监级别。而她和王伟的恋情也瓜熟蒂落，领证结婚过上了幸福生活。不料，公司突然出现空降兵海归凯西，同为人事经理，要和拉拉竞争人事总监。凯西比拉拉年轻，但能力丝毫不逊色。两人在公司的人事招聘、年会方案等工作中短兵相接，好几次拉拉都险些败下阵来。拉拉感到压力巨大，总监之位也摇摇欲坠。但拉拉没想到的是，凯西和王家相识已久，尤其受到婆婆陆爱华的喜爱。凯西深受西方文化熏陶，想当然的和王家走的很近，给拉拉带来了不少麻烦。拉拉虽是职场精英，却是个家庭菜鸟。起初她在平衡职场和家庭间奔命，惹出不少风波，甚至和王伟有了矛盾。但拉拉骨子里的善良坚持，让她逐渐成长。最终，拉拉凭借自己的努力与对家庭的真心维护，赢得了婆婆喜爱，成长为一名好妻子好媳妇，过上了职场家庭双丰收幸福的生活。

programme.desc: 《狂飙》电视剧是由爱奇艺、留白影视出品，由中央政法宣传教育局，中央政委政法综治信息中心指导，徐纪周执导，张译、张颂文、李一桐、张志坚领衔主演，韩童生特邀主演，吴健、郝平友情出演，高叶、贾冰、李健主演。该剧是一部黑恶势力崛起的编年史，细数黑恶毒瘤非法生长的升级路，一部扫黑除恶坚决斗争的回忆录，横跨20年的群像叙事全景式展现时代变迁下的黑白较量与复杂人性。

programme.title: 大侠霍元甲
programme.desc: 《大侠霍元甲》电视剧是由柏杉、刘方执导，赵文卓领衔主演，毛林林、释小龙、王之一、贾宏伟、吴超、寇家瑞主演的中华武术正剧。该剧讲述了清朝末年，一代武术宗师霍元甲面对内忧外患的国家危难，以中华武术精神抵御外国势力，捍卫民族尊严的传奇故事。戊戌变法失败后，“六君子”以身殉国。深受谭嗣同爱国热忱感染的霍元甲，欲投身历史洪流之中有所作为，却屡屡碰壁，竟只能眼睁睁看着英雄殉国。随后不久，八国联军侵华，大刀王五为御外辱，玉碎成仁。霍元甲得知消息连夜去为义兄收尸，虽然让王五留存全尸，却给霍家引来大祸，致使霍氏男丁尽死。一年后，隐居沧州的霍元甲出山走镖，却不想又陷入仇家圈套之中，费尽千辛万苦，虽然洗脱干系，却让他心灰意冷，他由此决定南下上海。霍元甲的精武门很快就在上海立住了脚跟，霍元甲的名气也越来越大。这让已经将侵华列为国策的日本人十分不满，面对日本人的挑衅，霍元甲带病上阵，在与日本人的最后较量中斗智斗勇，最终凭借过人的胆识挫败了日本人的阴谋。

programme.title: 快乐向前冲
programme.desc: 山东有线电视中心2009年为支持全运会，山东电视综艺频道推出了全新的一项大众娱乐节目《全运向前冲》。2010年《全运向前冲》全新升级为《快乐向前冲》,在每天下午 18点40分在综艺频道播出，闯关成功者可获得价值千元的礼品。《快乐向前冲》在济南世际园和威海大乳山度假区院内开设了两个录制地点。全程共设六道关卡，分别是“逆水行舟”、“水上一板”、“水上滑杠”、“疯狂单杠”、“高空双桥”和“攀登在行”。

programme.title: 生活帮大健康
programme.desc: 《生活帮》开播以来受到越来越多的观众的喜爱，节目收视率快速提升。节目以其“帮办”的独特风格，成为山东电视媒体中服务百姓的新军和后起之秀。为进一步打造《生活帮》知名度，塑造名牌栏目形象，《生活帮》活动推广组启动了进社区活动，在全省范围内联合几十家基层政府组织走进社区。受到了广大观众和社会各界人士的广泛好评。2009年7月12日，在中国电视民生新闻十年回顾展评会上，《生活帮》受到评委会专家们的一致好评，从众多民生新闻栏目中脱颖而出，荣获“中国电视民生新闻十佳栏目”。深受观众喜爱的《生活帮》主持人----帮主 《生活帮》节目主持人-阿速(13张)，同样得到了评委会专家们的肯定和称赞，获“中国电视民生新闻最具人气主持人”。开播三周年的《生活帮》如今枝繁叶茂，喜获双丰收。

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are on the case in the ultimate dino detective mystery! Park Ranger Tara is close to completing her dino guidebook but needs a scan of a T-Rex to finish it. Then, Park Rangers Asher and Darren discover mysterious dino footprints in the ground and decide to follow the trail on an exciting adventure. Finally, Park Ranger Zoe discovers a theory about a Flying T-Rex, and the rangers set out to prove if this incredible dinosaur truly exists!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super silly day of ranger fails! First, Park Ranger Darren accidentally gets his night vision goggles stuck on his head, leaving him unable to see properly. Park Ranger Asher has to step up to be Darren's eyes and ears to guide him! Then, in another silly mishap, Darren accidentally gets hit with a sleepy dart! Can Park Rangers Asher and Naomi find the ingredients for the Wake Up Juice in time?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super fun day of pranks and rescues! While exploring the ranch, Rangers Tara and Asher stumble upon a series of pranks, including trick eggs bursting with silly spray! But who could be the prankster? Then, it's new Park Ranger Naomi's first day at the ranch! But things go awry when a pterodactyl swoops in and flies away with her important work. Can she find a way to get it back?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-quiet night in Oddsville! When a power cut strikes, all the Oddbods seek refuge at Fuse's house, ruining his plans to watch the big game. Then, a funky asteroid lands in the cul-de-sac and emits groovy pop music that puts everyone in a dance trance! The chaos continues when one of Newt's eggs gets zapped at the store and hatches into an adorable but monstrously hungry chick!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Slick sees Bubbles' talent for invention and decides he wants in on it, too. But after several failures, he takes a shortcut and 'borrows' one of her ideas, to disastrous effect! Then, Pogo makes himself homeless while playing a reckless game and is kindly taken in by Fuse. But it's not long before his prank-playing becomes insufferable. Plus, Bubbles discovers a possibly cursed ancient artifact.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi enjoys a unique Hawaiian adventure! He visits Kualoa Ranch to learn about oyster farming, driving a boat and discovering how oysters are harvested, grown and cleaned from the ocean. Then he takes to the skies in a helicopter, exploring its parts and uses while pointing out famous sights like waterfalls, Diamond Head and Waikiki Beach on a scenic tour.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi, Meekah and their friend Emily for a day of building and science! The adventure begins as they work together to build a great big fort in the living room using household items and mega blocks. Afterwards they team up with aerospace engineer Emily Calandrelli for some fizzy fun, doing cool science experiments with baking soda, vinegar and oobleck!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's farm fun time with Blippi! First, he visits Gilchrist Farm and learns all about the animals. He takes a fun pony ride, feeds the birds, grooms the horses and even milks a goat! Then, Blippi and Meekah head to another ranch for a different kind of farm fun. They work together to farm some fresh fruits and veggies from the garden and then turn them into delicious, frozen popsicles. YUM!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is learning all about amazing community heroes! His adventure starts with a visit to Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children where he meets the doctors, volunteers and even a therapy dog named Doctor Ted. After his hospital tour he meets another helpful person, a hairstylist at Bubble Cuts Salon, where he gets a fun new haircut!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo as they get caught in bizarre traps and make crazy escapes! The trouble starts when a plant's magical aroma draws them inside, but then they can't get back out. On another adventure, they run towards a tasty berry but don't realize their path is blocked by quicksand! From getting spooked by a bug zapper to having an uninvited guest with a huge appetite move into their home, Joey and Boo must always find a clever way to escape!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions and robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo and his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, and a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him and Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He and D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors and why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert and helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is your guide to having fun and healthy days! First, have some fun in the sun while learning from Señor Super Sunscreen how to apply sunscreen properly. After a long day of fun, it's time for bed, as a magical book reads a bedtime story about the benefits of a good night's rest!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. Then, after a near-accident, Bubbles creates a health serum to improve a cow's intelligence, but a guinea pig eats it instead and develops a super-brain! Finally, it's photo day, and Slick is determined to make sure he's front and center in the picture this year.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to play JJ's favorite games! Join Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch kids as they play 'follow the leader' and have a contest to see who can make the silliest funny face. The fun continues with vehicles, as Grandpa makes a cool choo-choo train out of cardboard boxes and the kids play with different construction vehicles in a giant sandpit.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to learn the fundamentals with JJ! From learning shapes to making yummy rainbow popsicles, this adventure is full of learning fun!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on a fun learning adventure! First, playing dress-up is so much fun! Baby John transforms into a pirate, Jack is an astronaut and Jill is a beautiful princess! 新闻掏宝
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报道，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: Messy Goes To Okido S3, Ep 20
Jojo and Gran Gran S1, Ep 8
Messy Goes To Okido S3, Ep 21
Holy Flame Of The Martial World
Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. _x000D_An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one.

Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers

The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: CINTA BERAKHIR BAHAGIA 16 [P13]
programme.desc: Adisty, a beautiful young woman who serves as the backbone of her family, nearly becomes a sex worker to pay off her family’s debts. However, fate brings her together with Pasha, a respectable man from a wealthy family. Unbeknownst to them, they were actually switched at birth. What will happen to Adisty and Pasha’s lives?

programme.title: TEBARAN HATI EPS 66 [P13]
programme.desc: This story begins with Ariana, a renowned reporter and the adopted daughter of the respected Prawira family. She is willing to sacrifice everything to protect the good name of the family that raised her. When Ladya, her adopted younger sister, becomes depressed after getting pregnant out of wedlock and being abandoned by her boyfriend who flees abroad, to the point of attempting suicide, Ariana is asked by her adoptive mother, Indar, to claim the baby as her own. This decision shatters Ariana’s career and calls off her wedding to Kai, her boyfriend from a wealthy family.

programme.title: CINTA TANPA KARENA EPS 446 [P13]
programme.desc: Couple of lovers who are prevented from being together by their parents' approval. They are Dipta (Megantara) and Nuna (Ochi Rosdiana), and they must maintain their love in secret. Due to Nuna's mother's blockade, their love tale must overcome numerous challenges

programme.title: THEATER DRAMA : LAGI-LAGI MENGEJAR CINTA OLGA [P13]
programme.desc: A program drama FTV about love, friendship, family, happy, sad etc, played by popular actor and actress Indonesia.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 101 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 44 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: 99 NAMA CINTA 26 [P13]
programme.desc: Talia lives under the spotlight of cameras and the heat of celebrity news. Since her fiancé passed away, she has kept her heart tightly closed. To her, love only brings loss. Meanwhile, Kiblat is a respected young ustad—calm, courteous, and firm in his principles. His life is well-directed—until an incident brings him face-to-face with Talia in a heated argument over a minor accident. They instantly dislike each other. Unbeknownst to them, their parents have long been bound by a promise: to arrange their children’s marriage. When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husband—Lala enters the third season of the Champion of Chef cooking competition, and her victory brings her closer to Julian, one of the judges in the competition.

programme.title: CINTA TANPA KARENA EPS 447 [P13]
programme.desc: Couple of lovers who are prevented from being together by their parents' approval. They are Dipta (Megantara) and Nuna (Ochi Rosdiana), and they must maintain their love in secret. Due to Nuna's mother's blockade, their love tale must overcome numerous challenges

programme.title: CINTA SEPENUH JIWA EPS 71 [P13]
programme.desc: Lala is a young girl, the second daughter of Andi and Desi, who since childhood has carried enthusiasm and a smile with her every step. Her life is simple but full of color thanks to one thing she truly loves: cooking. For Lala, the kitchen is not just a place to prepare ingredients. It is a space for expression, a place where she pours out her emotions, wraps stories into every seasoning, and serves love through every dish. With the support of Hasbi—her boyfriend who later becomes her husband—Lala enters the third season of the Champion of Chef cooking competition, and her victory brings her closer to Julian, one of the judges in the competition.

programme.title: MENCINTAI IPAR SENDIRI EPS 102 [P13]
programme.desc: Ayuna, a beauty vlogger and model, finishes a shoot and is picked up by her younger sister, Bella. Bella takes Ayuna to a workshop to give her a surprise: Ayuna’s sports car has been upgraded as a gift, since Bella is getting married before her older sister. Bella then asks Ayuna to have one last race on a deserted road as her farewell to the racing world, a request that Ayuna agrees to with a heavy heart.

programme.title: 99 NAMA CINTA 27 [P13]
programme.desc: Talia lives under the spotlight of cameras and the heat of celebrity news. Since her fiancé passed away, she has kept her heart tightly closed. To her, love only brings loss. Meanwhile, Kiblat is a respected young ustad—calm, courteous, and firm in his principles. His life is well-directed—until an incident brings him face-to-face with Talia in a heated argument over a minor accident. They instantly dislike each other. Unbeknownst to them, their parents have long been bound by a promise: to arrange their children’s marriage. When Hasanah, Kiblat’s mother, falls ill and pleads to see her son married before it’s too late, Kiblat is faced with a great dilemma—follow his heart or fulfill his duty to his parents.

programme.title: KESETIAAN JANJI CINTA EPS 45 [P13]
programme.desc: Meira no longer feels happy in her marriage. Lately, Arya, her husband, constantly looks for faults in her. As a result, Meira and Arya often get into arguments. The situation reaches its peak when Arya refuses to provide for Meira anymore. He even refuses to help cover the medical expenses of Meira’s mother, Siti. Arya also stops paying for Lani’s college tuition, Meira’s younger sister. Even though, before they got married, it was Arya who promised Meira that he would cover all of her living expenses as well as her family’s, so that she could focus on being a housewife.

programme.title: Tur-Bros / The Snailman
programme.desc: During a visit to a racing convention Turbo is kidnapped by an overzealous fan and it's up to the rest of the FAST crew to save him. // Turbo throws a wild race for his fellow insects, but is surprised when his old nemesis, Guy Gagne, returns for a rematch.

programme.title: Big Fun Town / New Crackridge
programme.desc: Archibald and Bea plan another couple's long overdue honeymoon. Is a tornado coming to Crackridge? Archibald sure seems to think so.

programme.title: The Case Of The Diabolo
programme.desc: Noddy's delighted to be given a diabolo by Big Ears. But when Noddy tries it out for the first time, the diabolo crashes and breaks in two. Even worse, when Noddy goes to retrieve the two halves, he finds that they're both missing! Noddy needs to investigate. Where is his new toy?

programme.title: The Case Of The Vanished Trophy
programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings invites the toys to play a game of Catch the Flag at the castle. But when the special trophy goes missing, Noddy has to investigate. Where is the vanished trophy?

programme.title: The Case Of The Lost Cows
programme.desc: When Train hears cows near the railway tracks, he's worried that he might scare them and he insists on going really slow. Trouble is there's a load of Builders on board who need to get to Brickabuild fast. Noddy decides to investigate. Where are the lost cows?

programme.title: The Case Of The Burst Tyres
programme.desc: There's a race at the loop-the-loop. Deltoid brings the prize for the winner: a beautiful model of the loop the loop circuit made by Pat Pat and Smartysaurus. All the toys are very excited, but before the race starts the tyres of Deltoid's tribike are burst! Could it be one of the contestants trying to prevent him from winning the race? Noddy needs to find out so that the race can take place.

programme.title: Why Rhino Charges
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Rhino didn't charge and he couldn't see very well at all. Poor old Rhino really wanted to be invited to the Dance of the Horns up on the plains with Buffalo and all the other horned animals. But Rhino didn't have a horn, so he wasn't allowed. The Monkeys decide to help Rhino and make him a horn from a piece of old wood. But when Rhino wakes up he doesn't know what it is. ‘Aargh! Thing on the end of my nose! CHAAaarge!' And that's Why Rhino Charges.

programme.title: Why Caterpillar Is Never In A Hurry
programme.desc: You see Caterpillar was never in a hurry. When all the animals were racing around Tinga Tinga getting ready for the Best-dressed parade, Caterpillar was happy to sit in a tree and munch on leaves saying ‘Po-le, po-le, slowly, slowly, good things come to those who wait'. Then one day the rains come and Caterpillar disappears into a cocoon. ‘What's happening?' questions Elephant. ‘Wait and see' says Tortoise wisely ‘Wait and See'.

programme.title: Postman Pat And The Flying Shark
programme.desc: Julian is very excited about the Sealife Awareness Day at Greendale School. While he's talking to Pat about it, his dad gets a call from Ben - a special delivery! Pat discovers it's a giant inflatable shark which is to be the surprise centrepiece of the Sealife day. But when Pat stops to help Alf mend a gate, a mix-up with parcel tape ends up with the whale accidentally inflating and floating off...

programme.title: Postman Pat And The Blue Flash
programme.desc: Pat must deliver Ben to Greendale School, dressed as superhero, The Blue Flash. But Ben keeps stopping to help people on the way and his costume gets increasingly ruined! Meanwhile at the school, Julian can't wait to meet his hero but Sarah Gilbertson insists that The Blue Flash isn't real... At last Pat arrives at the school with Ben wearing a new costume hastily cobbled together by Pat. Julian isn't fooled. Looks like The Blue Flash isn't real after all...

programme.title: Roary's Demolition Derby
programme.desc: Roary is in a mischievous mood and keeps crashing into things. Big Chris has a great idea how Roary can burn up all his energy and be helpful at the same time!

programme.title: Manners Please
programme.desc: Farmer Green and FB are very nervous about going to Mama Mia's garden party. James and the other cars offer to teach them how to behave at such an event. But everything doesn't quite go to plan…

programme.title: Big Chris' Big Jump
programme.desc: Big Chris has agreed to do a parachute jump for charity but loses his nerve on the big day. Can Roary talk him through it, just like Big Chris did for him when he got scared?

programme.title: Brassless Bandfinal
programme.desc: The brass band booked for the Silver Hatch parade have cancelled. Mr Carburettor will be furious if he doesn't have music at his parade. Roary and his friends think up an ingenious plan...

programme.title: Somewhere / Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family he’s a unicorn. / Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: Tacos / Rainy Day
programme.desc: When Kelp is introduced to crunchy tacos in Unicorn Land, he must use his bubble sparks to bring them back to his family underwater. / Kelp’s unicorn friends are going to teach him Swishbee on land. But it rains and the game is called off until Kelp shows them that playing in the water can be even more fun.

programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that she’s afraid to try new things because she doesn’t want to make mistakes-why mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.desc: When Fishlegs discovers a hidden civilization of Albino Night Terrors beneath Dragon's Edge, he must craft an escape plan after they attack the Riders.

programme.desc: Boss Baby encounters a new threat to Baby Love: an adorable Baby TV show starring Pyg the Pygmy Goat, Tam the Tamandua, and their host Maria-Maria. Boss is told not to go to Corporate War by Board Baby Emiliano, so Boss tries to provoke his enemies to make the first move.

programme.title: Conference Room B
programme.desc: Boss promises Tim he'll help make their parents' anniversary present, but after Puppy Co. and Baby Corp's fight over a conference room escalates, he sends Hendershot is his stead. Hendershot, armed with a file on all of Tim's wants and needs, tries to keep Tim happy.

programme.title: Captain Underpants And The Senseless Torment Of The Space Toilet
programme.desc: Inspired by their favorite TV show, George and Harold - along with Principal Krupp - blast off to outer space, where an angry toilet awaits.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absentee Aliens
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Hazardous Hysteria of the Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months - everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.desc: Stoick, Hiccup and Snotlout search for Spitelout when he goes missing, and ultimately find him on a distant island battling a fiery Singetail dragon.

programme.title: Buffalord Soldier
programme.desc: Astrid comes down with the Odin's Revenge flu and the Riders must search for the cure by finding a nearly extinct Buffalord dragon before Viggo does.

programme.title: A Grim Retreat
programme.desc: The Riders head to a tropical island for fun in the sun, not realizing it's infested with Grimora Leeches which drives their dragons to turn on them.

programme.title: Enter the Dragon Master
programme.desc: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu

programme.title: Blue Dragon Plays with Fire
programme.desc: When the kids grow over-confident after beginning their training, they decide to intercept a distress call and sneak off without permission, only to land themselves in hot water

programme.title: Blade of the Red Phoenix
programme.desc: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll

programme.title: Becoming Part 1

programme.title: Becoming Part 2
programme.desc: Jim warms up to the idea of being the Trollhunter until he faces Bular, who is determined to destroy him, so he seeks help in Blinky and AAARRRGGHH!!

programme.title: Wherefore Art Thou Trollhunter?
programme.desc: Jim is not welcomed by the Trolls as their new Trollhunter, and he suffers a humiliating defeat at the hands of Draal

programme.desc: It’s revealed that Cleve is building a massive weather machine that is generating dangerous desert storms, with the help of a genius North African teen named Ziri. When Cleve creates a sandstorm to take out the crew, they’re saved by two Bedouin brothers named Kareem and Salem (and their pack of camels). Echo questions her ability to be a good leader and if they should give up.

programme.title: The Eye of the Sahara
programme.desc: The kids manage to make it through the crazy storm and build gliders out of parts of the fallen spy plane to travel closer to Cleve’s base and save Nowhere and Gary. Cleve sees the kids on his satellite feeds and sends a bunch of drones to take them out. During the aerial battle, Cisco splits off and leads the drones away so that the rest of the crew can escape, causing him to be lost alone in the giant storm

programme.title: MEGA Fights Carlos Manuel Baldomir vs. Arturo Gatti
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features welterweights Carlos Manuel Baldomir, aka 'Tata' (42-9, 12 KOs) vs. Arturo 'Thunder' Gatti (40-7, 31 KOs) in a bout to unify the WBC and IBA titles. The fight took place at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on July 22, 2006.

programme.title: Fukuoka 2023 - Episode 1
programme.desc: Fukuoka, Japan welcomes the top talent in the world of martial arts when Karate 1 Premier League returns. The World Karate Federation expects another tremendous turnout, featuring Olympic medalists and world-ranked competitors, when the Karate 1 Premier League visits the port city of Fukuoka, Japan, on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: MEGA Fights Jan Zaveck vs. Andre Berto
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features the IBF Welterweight title bout, Jan Zaveck, aka 'Mr. Sympathicus', (31-1, 18 KOs) vs. Andre Berto (27-1, 21 KOs) from Beau Rivage Resort and Casino in Biloxi, Mississippi, USA, on September 3, 2011. Andre Berto, coming off losing the WBC title to Victor Ortiz, was looking for vengeance against Zaveck.

programme.title: Biomechanics of Body Preparation
programme.desc: In this episode we follow one of our martial artists as he goes through a grueling tournament and how he uses technology to help him prepare for it.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Joe Calzaghe vs. Roy Jones, Jr.
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light heavyweight championship fight featuring Joe Calzaghe and Roy Jones, Jr. This epic bout would prove to be the last of Calzage's career. Many wanted him to retire because he had nothing left to prove, and Calzaghe would officially do so 3 months later. Also on the card, Chris Arreola shows everyone why he is a heavyweight contender.

programme.title: Osaka, Japan: Show 4
programme.desc: Top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 4 features Abi, Kakuryu, Hakuho and Shodaii from the Osaka Prefectural Gymnasium in Osaka, Japan.

programme.title: Hague Grand Prix
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Hague Grand Prix and we follow some of Netherlands' judo heroes as they try to mark the event with a medal tally to be proud of.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: France + Vietnam
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates is television's best travel show that never leaves the kitchen. Skilled Chef Craig Wong is your host, and prepare to be blown away by his takes on the foods of France and Vietnam. First up? A re-write of a popular Vietnamese street snack made with Clams and Sesame Rice Noodles. Next? Marrow Toast dresses up in its tux and tails for a version made with King Oyster Mushrooms and Sauce Bordelaise. The common ingredient is Baguette; check out supersonic versions of French Jambon Beurre and Vietnamese Banh Mi. The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

programme.title: France, Japan, Morocco, Mexico
programme.desc: Join chef Pino Di Cerbo in the Global Veggies kitchen as he creates veggie dishes inspired by France - French Fennel Soup, Japan - Unagi-Style Soy Glazed Figs, Morocco - Moroccan Butterbean Tagine, and Mexico - Asparagus Ceviche!

programme.title: Cassoulet
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: USA + India
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: Iceland + Jamaica
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience; Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: Ireland + Japan
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: Dine Your Sign - Spring Special
programme.desc: On the Dine Your Sign Spring Special, Chef Siobhan Detkavich is cooking for Aries, Taurus, and Gemini! First, quiche with the season’s most delicious gifts – tender asparagus and earthy morels – suspended in silky custard and smothered in creamy fontina cheese! Next, spring lamb is stuffed with a sprightly pesto of mint and dandelion greens and roasted with shallots and new potatoes. Then, it’s an easy, healthy halibut dish with ramps (aka ‘wild garlic’) and grassy fiddleheads – the fish is steamed and finished with a sizzling pour over oil treatment that leaves the kitchen smelling like heaven! Finally, dessert a spring sign is sure to love: buttery, flaky croissant, stuffed with rich mascarpone cheese and tangy, sweet, balsamic-marinated strawberries! Hooray Spring!

programme.title: Madagascar + Belgium
programme.desc: First up, Belgium is famous for its mussels and fries, aka 'Moule Frite'. Chef Wong has a unique take featuring Belgian beer steamed mussels salad, waffle cut fries, and potato-leek mousse. Next, Steak Madagascar is an old school fine-dining fave, this take, uses modernist 'spherification' for the sauce, and a vanilla bean rub for a steak that is decidedly not 'old school', wow! For a common ingredient, how about sweet breakfast? Belgians are famous for Liege Waffles, and Madagascar loves Mofogasy, a pancake made with rice flour and coconut. The final dish is inspired by Belgian Waterzooi, a root veggie stew, mixed with a popular Malagesy stir-fry with shellfish and pork... Chef carefully and skillfully balances all the elements, using lobster, bacon breadcrumbs, and adding a modern touch with mango pickle 'pearls'!

programme.title: Peru + Lebanon
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra. Squab is on the final plate blending Lebanese flavours like sumac, pomegranate, and pistachio with Peruvian ones like sweet corn, squash, and lime. What a CombiNation!

programme.title: South Africa + Portugal
programme.desc: This CombiNation Plates culinary adventure starts in Portugal with a Scallop dish that features some of their finest ingredients, such as Port Wine, ChouricÌ§o sausage, Kale, and Figs. Next up is South Africa and the feature is an Ostrich Steak, served with native Cape Gooseberries, the bizarrely named "Monkey Gland Sauce" (don't worry, no monkeys and very few glands are involved). The common ingredient is Peri Peri peppers, featured first on a Grilled Sardine with Olive Soil for a peak Portugal experience, then on the Peri Peri Chicken dish that South Africa made internationally famous. The combination plate is always the big finale... Stand back in awe for Chef Craig's Giant Braaied (aka 'grilled') Veal Chop with Clams 'Alentejana', served with a sweet-tart tropical Fruit Salad to balance the plate.

programme.desc: Chef Craig Wong loves cooking lamb, and with his expert advice, you will too!

programme.title: Traditional Japanese Food
programme.desc: Chef and cookbook author Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen schools us on traditional Japanese foods as she makes tofu rice pockets, miso glazes, and rice flour dumplings.

programme.title: Hong Kong Foodie Favourites
programme.desc: Cantonese expert Mary Tang showcases traditional dishes from the Chinese coastal territory, Hong Kong. To kick off the episode, Mary rolls up and steams a batch of fluffy Shrimp Dumplings. Next, tender beef with chewy rice noodles and fermented black beans is on the menu. This dish is doused in a fun and tasty dressing featuring salty soy sauce, tart Shaoxing wine, sweet oyster sauce, and a medley of spices. With a sturdy clay pot, Mary then cooks up some savoury Chinese sausage and lays it on a bed of aromatic rice. To top it off, why not some delicious Pineapple Buns? These buns are pillowy and sweet; you'll be surprised to hear that they contain zero pineapple!

programme.title: Vietnamese Street Food
programme.desc: There's nothing more authentic than street food - Vietnamese style! Host Lisa Nguyen shares her tips and tricks on tasty Lemongrass-infused Beef Wraps. A vast array of ingredients including peppery betel leaves, gorgeous greens and crunchy peanuts complement the tenderness of flavoursome, marinated ground beef. Lisa's next dish is an iconic Vietnamese street food - crispy Sizzling Crepes with juicy pork belly and earthy vegetables will definitely activate your taste buds. For dessert, Lisa whips up a batch of sweet coconut pudding using beautiful bananas and velvety coconut milk sprinkled with roasted sesame seeds for some crunch.

programme.title: Sweet and Sour
programme.desc: Sweet and sour are definitely on the menu as Thai-born chef Pailin Chongchitnant whips up glass noodle salad, sour curry, sweet and sour stir fry, and pineapple and lychee in iced syrup.

programme.title: Cantonese Seafood
programme.desc: Bring on the seafood! Home cook Mary Tang kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen 3 with a unique dish featuring chewy clams, sweet and bitter fermented black beans, and a collection of spices. Next, she makes us her favourite shrimp dish - Shrimp and Egg Fried Rice. Fluffy egg bits, lightly flavoured nutty brown rice, and a pop of tender shrimp works wonders for the taste buds. A common appetizer, Mary then walks us through a spicy concoction of deep-fried salt and pepper squid or Calamari. And who doesn't love lobster? Mary finishes off with Cantonese Lobster with Ginger and Scallions (yes, it tastes as good as it sounds!). A Cantonese take on the juicy protein, this dish is fried in hot bubbling oil for a golden-brown crust, and steamed in great Shaoxing wine and salty soy sauce for some flavour.

programme.title: Gelatin Episode with Chef Craig Wong

programme.title: Ponzu sauce

programme.title: Hanoi Specialties
programme.desc: Simple, fun, and magically tasty, some of Vietnam's most delicious and well-known foods come from its capital city of Hanoi. Vietnamese expert Lisa Nguyen shares her knowledge of Hanoi dishes by starting off with a sweet, sour, and spicy papaya salad called Goi Du Du. With a popular nuoc cham dressing featuring sugar, lime juice and Thai chili drizzled over a medley of crunchy carrots, fresh cilantro and mint, chewy papaya, and shrimp, this dish is the perfect balance of wonderful flavours and textures. Also on the menu, grilled-to-perfection Pork Patties with a rich caramel sauce. Fresh fragrant dill and golden turmeric elevate Lisa's next dish as she cooks up some mahi-mahi to enjoy with a beer. To finish off, Lisa exquisitely prepares Vietnam's most popular dish - Pho.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: It's time for fun and games with all our friends! First, Jill is shy at her first mermaid swimming class, but she learns to have fun and trust herself with the help of her friends. Then, during a Mexican posada, Manny teaches Baby John how to build a piñata. After he gets over being a little scared of the blindfold, he has lots of fun! The fun continues as the friends learn to compromise when they have opposite ideas for playtime.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about yummy food! First, he explores the world of vegetables and learns that they are not only delicious but also essential for staying strong and healthy. Then, the family has fun making and tasting all sorts of delicious and healthy fruit juices. The tasty adventure continues as the kids learn to make colorful popsicles with yummy fruits and Miss Hannah turns healthy fruit into fun animal faces!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume and pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar and his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he and his friends encounter a lost baby duckling and lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to play JJ's favorite games! Join Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch kids as they play 'follow the leader' and have a contest to see who can make the silliest funny face. Then, JJ and his animal friends have a party where they play freeze dance! The fun continues with vehicles, as Grandpa makes a cool choo-choo train out of cardboard boxes and the kids play with different construction vehicles in a giant sandpit.

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: Join Cody as he learns how to be a good brother and a good friend! In a heartwarming moment, Cody finds out he's going to be a big brother. After some initial nerves, he spends a special day with his mama and her baby bump. Then, the big day arrives as the family brings his new sister, Kendi, home! Watch Cody take on his new role, helping Kendi get to sleep and learning to play new games together like bouncing a balloon.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia and Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks and get nice and clean in the tub. After the bath, it's time to get into pajamas and play a fun game of Peek-a-boo with Mummy using lots of different objects from around the house. Finally, it's time for bed as Daddy and Ella take turns giving Max a cuddle and a teddy bear before he goes to sleep. Night night!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko is busy stopping Mr. Weasel's wacky schemes! First, Gecko and Weasel face off in a football match, but Weasel starts cheating! Gecko must fix his damaged teammates and teach Weasel a lesson. Then, Bobby the Bus's battery goes missing, and all clues point to Weasel! The schemes continue as Weasel tries to show off at a 'fix up fair' but needs rescuing, and he steals cakes from a bake sale but ends up crashing!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko and the Mechanicals face a big test of skill and teamwork! First, the Mechs are in Garage School when a real emergency comes in. In a role reversal, they must fix Fiona the Firetruck's starter motor while Gecko instructs them! Then, when Blue crashes during a flying race, Gecko must show his skill to repair him. The day ends with a big American football game where Gecko comes up with a clever strategy and a creative fix to help his team win!

programme.title: Cody Time
programme.desc: What will Cody do today? Every day is a new adventure! He might move to a new house with his family and cat, Pickles. Or maybe he'll find a simple empty cardboard box and use his imagination to turn it into a turtle shell, a drum and a race car! He could go on a hike with JJ and race walnut sailboats, or stay home and sing the ABCs over a big pot of alphabet soup. With Cody, you never know what fun you'll have!

programme.title: CeCe Time
programme.desc: It's CeCe Time, full of kittens, tutus and fun! The big day arrives when CeCe gets her very own adorable kitten! She loves her new friend and wants to put on a show, so she gets in her ballerina outfit to dance for her kitty. Then, after hosting many tea parties for her stuffed animals, CeCe invites her real friends JJ and Bella over for a high tea party! From ice skating with Mom to imagining stick ponies are unicorns, it's always a fun and graceful day with CeCe!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi wants to find out how awesome things work! He and D.BO visit a construction site where they learn all about safety and how a crane works. Then, they meet Frankie the Firetruck to see all of her amazing fire-fighting abilities in action! After that, it's time for some speed as they meet an F1 race car and a giant monster truck to learn what makes them so special. Finally, Blippi shrinks down to see how a guitar makes beautiful music!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of helping each other at Lellobee City Farm! Then, when Heidi the Horse is feeling down in the dumps, Ella and all the friends put on a show and give her a big group hug to make her feel happy again! programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
